title: Remind me
subtitle: A nudge at the time you pick
description: Say what and when, in your own words. Your Sylo sets a reminder that arrives as a notification and a message at that time: once, every day, on the weekdays you pick, several times a day, or every month. It only tells you: when the time comes it sends nothing and does nothing else.
asks: Remind me to call mom tomorrow at 6.
Every weekday at 8:30, remind me to take my vitamins.
Remind me every 2 hours to drink water.
